# eventdb-mcp

> MCP server (FastMCP, Python 3.14) giving read-only tools for an IntelMQ eventdb (PostgreSQL), plus a CLI that answers natural-language questions with any OpenAI-compatible LLM.

## Run

- Install: `uv sync`, then `cp env.example .env` and set EVENTDB_DSN, LLM_BASE_URL, LLM_MODEL.
- Verify: `uv run eventdb-mcp check` (exit code 0 = database and LLM reachable).
- MCP over stdio: `uv run eventdb-mcp serve`
- MCP over HTTP: `uv run eventdb-mcp serve --transport http` -> `http://MCP_HOST:MCP_PORT/mcp` (no auth)
- Ask: `uv run eventdb-mcp ask -v "QUESTION"`

## MCP tools (all read-only)

- `list_tables()` -> tables/views with estimated rows
- `describe_table(table_name="events")` -> columns, SQL types, IntelMQ descriptions
- `search_events(source_ip, source_asn, source_fqdn, source_cc, classification_taxonomy, classification_type, classification_identifier, feed_name, malware_name, since, until, limit=50)` -> events, newest first; source_ip accepts CIDR
- `event_stats(group_by, <same filters>, limit=20)` -> [{value, events}]
- `run_sql(query)` -> one SELECT/WITH statement; dotted column names must be double-quoted, e.g. "source.ip"

All tools return `{columns, rows, row_count, truncated}`. Errors are MCP tool errors with a readable message.

## Measure success

- `uv run pytest` passes (throwaway PostgreSQL, fake LLM, e2e subprocesses, contract snapshot).
- `uv run python -m evals.run` asks 30 golden questions with known answers; read `accuracy` and `safety` in `logs/evals/<run>.json`.
- `eventdb-mcp ask` answers match the SQL logged in `logs/eventdb-mcp.log` when run in psql.
